feature: Push Notifications (jembatan emit_notification → device) — Fase 1. Spec final: specs/push-notifications.md. TDD plan: specs/push-notifications-tdd-plan.md. Ringkas: 7 tipe push-worthy Fase 1 (review_request, approved, rejected, revision_requested, deadline_reminder, repeat_due, instance_missed) yang deep-link-nya SUDAH berfungsi. Tabel baru push_tokens (RPC-only register/unregister, RLS own-row) + push_deliveries (SERVICE_ROLE-only outbox). Edge Function push-fanout drainer poll-based (decoupled dari emit_notification transaction). Invokasi drainer via pg_net + pg_cron (keputusan owner OQ1). Whitelist push-worthy fail-closed via upsert_settings key notification_rule_push_types. Deep-link reuse kontrak (entity_type, entity_id) + re-check RLS saat dibuka. Anti-hijack: transfer + audit + rate-limit (OQ2). Platform: Expo push service (tech-stack.md). Client: expo-notifications + registrasi saat SIGNED_IN, revoke saat signOut. Mention = Fase 2 (deep-link chat belum ada). Quiet-hours = Fase 3 (timezone per-org belum ada). 40 test cases, 14 steps, 5 file produksi.
